historical_reference.interpretation: Historical-only workflow-shape baseline. It is not an exact-current comparable sample because the suite fingerprint and test count can differ. It cannot establish current performance or speedup.

findings: Historical P0 test-body time was very small relative to total GitHub Actions job wall time.
Checkout, runner/action initialization, evidence production and artifact upload dominated more wall time than the historical unittest body.
Dropping adversarial tests would trade verification quality for negligible expected wall-time savings at the present suite scale.
Single-run timing answers how long one regression pass takes but does not measure repeated-run drift, intermittent failure latency or sustained stability.
A bounded endurance session is preferable to an always-on self-test loop because it collects repeated-run evidence without turning testing into permanent runtime load.
Timing comparisons must bind to an exact test-suite fingerprint and Python series; otherwise suite growth or runtime changes can be misread as performance regression or speedup.
At least 10 successful comparable cross-run samples are required before median/p95 are treated as a stable optimization diagnostic baseline.
Endurance duration and cross-run timing are not Experience, capability proof, Trust, Personality evidence, formal verification or real always-on runtime evidence.
Optimization must target information gained per unit test cost, not merely fewer seconds or fewer tests.

stop_conditions: target duration reached after minimum rounds
outputs: first-half vs second-half median drift ratio
time-to-first-failure by round/session position if a failure occurs

comparable_cross_run_trend.inclusion_rule: successful samples with the exact same comparison_group only

duration_strategy.tier_0_every_candidate_push: single exact-current regression timing plus one-sample trend diagnostic
duration_strategy.tier_1_bounded_endurance: 15-second target, trigger-gated or manual research run; intended to detect immediate intermittent failure and short-horizon drift
duration_strategy.tier_2_cross_run_baseline: collect >=10 exact comparison_group samples for median/p95 and recurring-slowest diagnostics
duration_strategy.tier_3_extended_endurance: candidate research only after evidence justifies it; proposed 60-second-class run, exact duration TEST_REQUIRED
duration_strategy.tier_4_long_endurance: not automatic; only after repeated anomaly or explicit research need because self-test load must not become its own bottleneck
duration_strategy.rule: Do not infer more confidence merely from longer duration. Duration is useful only when it increases failure-discovery or stability information under matched conditions.

optimization_research.hypothesis: Hosted CI setup overhead is larger than the test body, so repeated endurance should be trigger-gated rather than run on every push.
optimization_research.measurement: Compare single-run runner_total_duration to endurance session duration and runner_fraction_of_session.
optimization_research.optimization_if_supported: Keep one exact-current regression on every candidate push and run bounded endurance only on explicit research trigger/manual dispatch or anomaly.

optimization_research.hypothesis: A small subset of tests will dominate self-test wall time as the suite grows.
optimization_research.measurement: Track recurring slowest-test identity and per-suite duration across >=10 exact comparison_group samples using median/p95.
optimization_research.optimization_if_supported: Split slow deterministic simulation strata from fast safety-boundary tests only when repeated comparable timing evidence shows a material bottleneck; both remain required before candidate evidence is considered complete.

optimization_research.hypothesis: Longer self-test duration has diminishing information gain once round timing and failure discovery stabilize.
optimization_research.measurement: Compare failure discovery, p95 duration and first-half/second-half median drift as session length increases under matched comparison_group workloads.
optimization_research.optimization_if_supported: Introduce an adaptive stop rule only after multiple comparable sessions establish a precommitted stability envelope; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED and may not be selected after seeing the candidate result.

optimization_research.hypothesis: Process launch and evidence serialization may dominate repeated endurance overhead.
optimization_research.optimization_if_supported: Evaluate in-process repeated suite execution or batched evidence serialization only if isolation/non-regression tests show no cross-round state leakage.

optimization_research.hypothesis: In-process repetition can be faster but may hide state-leak defects that subprocess isolation exposes.
optimization_research.measurement: Paired comparison of isolated-process and same-process repetitions from matched snapshots with explicit state-reset and order tests.
optimization_research.optimization_if_supported: Use faster in-process mode only for analytics if it is non-inferior for defect detection; preserve isolated-process mode for authoritative candidate regression evidence until independently verified.

optimization_research.hypothesis: Self-test optimization can falsely look successful if test coverage, suite identity, assigned workload or verification quality declines.
optimization_research.measurement: Track suite_signature_sha256, test-count consistency, failure/error/skipped counts, assigned workload coverage and unchanged verification/risk boundaries.
optimization_research.optimization_if_supported: Reject any speed gain caused by skipped tests, changed comparison groups, selective deferral, weakened assertions or reduced evidence binding.

forbidden: stop because current result looks favorable
change duration after observing candidate advantage
mix different comparison groups in one baseline
count repeated test loops as Experience or autonomous life
promote real_5min_runtime_live from CI endurance duration

optimization_plan.action: Collect exact-current timing evidence for at least 10 successful samples with one exact comparison_group before declaring a stable cross-run diagnostic baseline.
optimization_plan.reason: Avoid optimizing from one noisy hosted-runner sample or mixing changed suites/Python series.

optimization_plan.action: Collect bounded endurance evidence separately and compare round median/p95, drift, comparison-group consistency and intermittent failures.
optimization_plan.reason: A fast single pass cannot reveal short-horizon repeated-run instability.

optimization_plan.action: Keep bounded endurance trigger-gated by default rather than running continuously on every candidate change.
optimization_plan.reason: Testing should reduce uncertainty without becoming a permanent source of runtime load or CI cost.

optimization_plan.action: Use recurring slowest-test frequency and per-suite median/p95 to choose optimization targets only after the comparable baseline becomes stable.
optimization_plan.reason: Optimize persistent measured bottlenecks instead of one-off noise.

optimization_plan.action: Do not enable adaptive stopping until thresholds are precommitted from comparable baseline evidence and validated against deliberately unstable positive controls.
optimization_plan.reason: Otherwise an adaptive stop rule can censor late failures and create false confidence.

optimization_plan.action: If suite duration grows materially, evaluate process reuse, suite partitioning and selective parallelism under explicit state-leak and coverage non-regression tests.
optimization_plan.reason: Execution-topology optimization should follow measured bottlenecks, not assumptions.

optimization_plan.action: Any speedup claim must use matched workloads, frozen metric definitions, equal verification/risk quality and repeated paired/crossover measurements.
optimization_plan.reason: Commit count, wake count, window age, runner uptime and raw test-loop duration are invalid capability evidence.

do_not_optimize_by: mixing different suite_signature_sha256 values or Python series into one baseline
changing duration after observing the result
counting heartbeat/poll/retry/self-test loops as productive Experience
using commit count as speed evidence
using awake time or runner uptime as speed evidence
relaxing P_base, Identity, Personality or Governance boundaries
